behavior: Preparation binds campaignId and buildOwnerCampaignId to the preparing campaign.
Verification binds campaignId to the target campaign and buildOwnerCampaignId to the unchanged artifact owner marker.
Explicit sharing validates all source artifacts, existing source/target identity and identical 8-case snapshots, then verifies and persists target binding.
Shared bindings preserve original owner through subsequent explicit sharing.
Only target build-binding is replaced. Previous binding raw bytes are archived. No ledger, credential file, profile, source binding or cache marker is copied or modified.
testsInclude: qualification to official sharing with independent ledger and synthetic encrypted-file bytes unchanged
exact raw archive of old target binding
original owner preserved across a second sharing
tampered artifact and buildOwner rejected without target replacement
limitations: Tests use real small artifact trees. No full clone/build or actual campaign binding in this bounded task.
Old experimental bindings without buildOwnerCampaignId are intentionally invalid. No migration or fallback added.
